placements.title: Formal verification gates and deployment controls ensuring artifact integrity before shipping
placements.frame: How do verification gates and quality review checkpoints govern release readiness across environments?

placements.title: Mandatory Signed Release Manifests Governing Deployment Authorization
placements.frame: What verification controls and signing requirements must be satisfied before artifacts can ship to staging and production environments?
placements.why: Quinton mandates a hard gate requiring signed release manifests for all Meridian release train deployments across staging and production following historical unsigned artifact incidents.
